title: High Performance Unstructured SpMM Computation Using Tensor Cores
problem: Tensor Cores impose strict data structure constraints that are incompatible with unstructured sparse matrices, limiting their use for sparse matrix-matrix multiplication. High-performance SpMM computation requires hardware support that existing accelerators do not adequately provide for unstructured sparsity patterns.
motivation: High-performance sparse matrix-matrix multiplication is critical for science and industry as ever-increasing data sizes prohibit using dense matrix representations.
method: SMaT is a block-sparse SpMM library that leverages the low-level CUDA MMA (matrix-matrix-accumulate) API to maximize Tensor Core performance for unstructured sparse matrices. The library employs sparse matrix permutation and block-sparse data structures to minimize non-zero blocks and improve computational efficiency. Algorithmic optimizations adapt Tensor Core constraints to work with irregular sparsity patterns through block-based representations.
key_novelty: Enabling Tensor Core acceleration of unstructured sparse matrix-matrix multiplication through block-sparse library design and the CUDA MMA API.
contributions: SMaT library design for efficient Tensor Core acceleration of unstructured SpMM workloads
Block-sparse approach leveraging CUDA MMA API for high-performance GPU utilization
Sparse matrix permutation optimization to minimize non-zero block overhead
2.6x average and up to 125x peak speedup compared to state-of-the-art libraries

metrics.speedup: up to 125x peak, 2.6x average vs DASP/cuSPARSE/Magicube

limitations: Limitations are not discussed in the abstract.
